purpose: Execute the atomic rotate-body-about-axis operation within the MA-16 boundary: One transient rigid rotation using Line.Create and Matrix.CreateRotation. It does not copy, attach, select, or validate orientation beyond volume preservation.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires rotate-body-about-axis and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: A closed nonempty transient body; attached DesignBody and component variants are excluded.

inputs.name: axis_origin_mm
inputs.description: Finite point on the rotation axis in millimetres.

inputs.name: axis_direction
inputs.description: Finite nonzero axis direction; normalized by the helper.

inputs.name: angle_degrees
inputs.description: Finite rotation angle in degrees; this is the current input name and is converted to radians.

inputs.name: volume_tolerance_mm3
inputs.description: Tolerance for the pre/post volume comparison.

preconditions: axis origin/direction are finite and direction is nonzero.
angle_degrees and volume_tolerance_mm3 are finite; tolerance is nonnegative.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The same transient body after one in-place rotation transform.

postconditions: The body is transformed once by Matrix.CreateRotation and its volume remains within volume_tolerance_mm3.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper; runtime execution is evidenced by the attached exact candidate host record; native persistence, visual review, and requested export remain outside this action.
implementation.notes: Execute the atomic rotate-body-about-axis operation within the MA-16 boundary: One transient rigid rotation using Line.Create and Matrix.CreateRotation. It does not copy, attach, select, or validate orientation beyond volume preservation. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.
